(1) INTL Face-ID/delay: /international-transfer with DE + Maria Garcia + IBAN DE89370400440532013000 + SWIFT DEUTDEFFXXX + £50 -> NO passcode/Face-ID/AuthGate DOM appears at any point; submit button transitions to spinner + 'Verifying transaction…' label (verified via innerText at t+600ms); inline receipt testID='intl-receipt' renders after ~3.4s with TRN=TRNOOWW46M2SVHR and FPID=FPMPSFWA312TW3KM; zero JS dialogs captured. action_items: No fixes required — all 4 reported changes verified working on preview (localhost:3000).
User-facing note: their production build is stale — they must redeploy to pick up these changes (as flagged in the review request).
Optional cleanup carried over from prior iterations: migrate shadow* props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style prop to silence RN deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: international-transfer.tsx has NO useAuthGate import, NO gate hook call, NO <authGate.Render/> mount — the AuthGate removal is complete. The 2400ms setTimeout precedes api.post('/transfers/international', ...) inside the try-block, so 'Verifying transaction…' is guaranteed to be visible for ~2.4s even on fast mocked adapters.
transactions.tsx correctly threads useCustomization()'s cc.header / cc.primary through header bg, active filter pill, download button border+icon+text, and RefreshControl tint.

offline-docs.ts buildStatementHtml + buildReceiptHtml both include Sort code + Account number in the .meta grid; statement adds Email + Phone. Values come from db.accounts (checking) and db.profile so they stay in sync with the active identity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Domestic transfer testids are recipient-name-input, sort-code-input, account-number-input, amount-input, description-input, transfer-now-button, confirm-send-btn (NOT prefixed with 'transfer-'). To inspect PDF HTML on web without touching Print.printAsync, stub navigator.canShare=()=>true and navigator.share=async({files})=>{ window.__x = await files[0].text(); } — offline-docs deliverPdf() prefers the Web Share API path first, so the HTML is passed to your stub. Passcode selectors: [data-testid="passcode-key-{0..9}"]. Intl receipt testIDs: intl-receipt, rcpt-trn, rcpt-fpid, rcpt-done.
